description: 2019 Belgian MSP - Princess Elizabeth Zone for renewable Energy in the Belgian Part of the North Sea is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Royal Belgian Institute of Natural Sciences (RBINS). This dataset represents the location of the Princess Elizabeth zone in the Belgian Part of the North Sea as described in the Royal Decree of May 22th, 2019, establishing a marine spatial plan for the period 2020-2026. Art. 8. § 3. Coverage: Royal Belgian Institute of Natural Sciences (RBINS). The publisher named on the listing is Royal Belgian Institute of Natural Sciences (RBINS). Its keywords include Bundesregierung, Reporting INSPIRE, marine spatial planning, Federale Overheid, Federal government, Gouvernement Fédéral. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XML. The listing shows 2026-06-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
